title: U.S. Navy and Air Force conduct joint search and rescue operations in support of Hurricane Harvey
description: 170830-N-ZN152-0001 COLLEGE STATION, Texas (Aug. 30, 2017) Sailors assigned to Helicopter Sea Combat Squadron (HSC) 7 and Airmen from the 48th Rescue Squadron prepare for joint Search and Rescue (SAR) operations utilizing small boats and aircraft throughout the areas affected by Hurricane Harvey. U.S. Navy and Air Force sent personnel and equipment to the area to bolster Northern Command's support of FEMA's disaster response efforts. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Ernest R. Scott)
